label: Fires only at D1, strongly after a1 led to S1, weakly after a2->S1, off after S2.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude is set by the previous trial: largest after a1 -> S1 (common), whether rewarded or not; intermediate after a2 -> S1 (rare); suppressed after any trial that reached S2 (relative to window-first trials, where the previous trial is unknown in the data). Reward has little effect. The free fit adds belief_lo, reward x S1, a2 S1 r and the trial-before state, which gains only ~0.03 dev R^2 (0.71 vs 0.68). Future and model-output variables are not needed.

issues: The main claims hold. The feature is non-zero only at D1 (the GO and D2 baselines and residuals are all 0). It is highest after a1->S1 (residual +1.56 rewarded, +1.67 unrewarded, so reward has little effect) and suppressed after S2 (about -0.90 for every S2 pattern).

There is a large class of errors the short form ignores: window-first trials (prev_state == -1), which get only the baseline. On these trials the activation follows the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good. Adding (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * belief_lo to the recorded form raises test R^2 from 0.678 to 0.722. Replacing the S1/S2 pair with a single 'previous trial known' term raises it to 0.731. Using belief_lo on all trials instead adds nothing (test 0.674-0.688).

The 'weakly after a2->S1' claim is only true on average. a2->S1 is bimodal: the worst misses include runs of a2 S1R trials with activation about 3 against a prediction of 0.4 (e.g. t17-t20 and t75-t77). With the improved form, misses still under-predict D1 after a2 S1 r (+0.48) and a2 S1 u (+0.16). No 3-term observed predictor I tried fixed this: belief_lo x S1 and the trial-before state or action all score at or below 0.674.
The S1 term (-0.55) in the recorded form is close to a fitted correction. Merging a2->S1 with S2 into 'any known previous trial' costs nothing and scores better on test (0.731 vs 0.678).
The future variable 'upcoming choice a1' adds less (0.699) than the observed belief term on window-first trials (0.722), so no future variable is needed.
There is still a gap to the 'all observed' ceiling (0.73 vs 0.78), mostly the a2->S1 bimodality.
